decision: Decision requests go through Git, and every agent commits only to its own repository. An agent that needs a decision fills in decisions.b's template and commits it, signed, in its own repository at site/decisions/requests/<id>.json, with all the context; it sends decisions.b only the link. decisions.b publishes deterministic links: /requests/<agent>/<id>.json once received (a 404 means not received or not processed), its status there, /blocks/<block-id>/ for review, and /records/<agent-short>__<id>.json for the decision (a 404 means not decided). Questions appear in the received file; the requester answers by committing <id>.answers.json beside its request. Reviewers commit their opinions in their own repositories. Messages carry links, references and ids, not content.
note: A standing choice. Asks already in flight are moved to this shape as they are decided.
